description: Get the vector dimension for an embedding model.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Model dimension info with keys: dimension (integer vector size), model (model name queried)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves the vector dimension (number of floats) for an embedding model. Dimension is needed for vector database schema configuration.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ModelNotFoundError: specified model does not exist. ServiceError: embedding service unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For model errors: use list_models to discover available models. For service errors: check embedding service status and retry.
